subtopic_title: Identification of coefficients of terms of algebraic expressions
curriculum_objective_text: Identify the positive and negative coefficients of a given algebraic term
text: Identify the negative coefficient of a given algebraic term.

record_links.rationale: The item asks for the coefficient of x in 10 - x - 2y + z, whose coefficient is -1.

heading_path.h3: Exercise 10.3: Identify parts of an algebraic expression

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 10.3: Identify parts of an algebraic expression 5. Answer the questions about this expression: $10 - x - 2y + z$. a) How many terms does this expression have? b) What is the coefficient of $x$? c) What is the coefficient of $z$? d) What is the value of the constant term?
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 10.3: Identify parts of an algebraic expression

5. Answer the questions about this expression: $10 - x - 2y + z$.

a) How many terms does this expression have?
b) What is the coefficient of $x$?
c) What is the coefficient of $z$?
d) What is the value of the constant term?
